catenaShort: Quoted from the Catena Aurea on the Gospel of St John, compiled by St Thomas Aquinas from the Fathers, in the Oxford translation of 1845 (public domain) as given in the Dominican House of Studies electronic edition, which modernises the second-person pronouns and omits the marginal references to each Father’s work.
catenaLong: The patristic commentary is quoted from the Catena Aurea on St John — the “golden chain” of the Fathers compiled by St Thomas Aquinas — in the Oxford translation of 1845 (public domain), as given in the Dominican House of Studies electronic edition, which modernises the second-person pronouns and omits the marginal references to each Father’s work; nothing is paraphrased. It is restricted here to Fathers venerated in the Orthodox Church, and to Blessed Theophylact of Ohrid, whose commentary on the Gospels is the standard Orthodox reading of them.
